title: selliguea bisulcata
intro: Selliguea bisulcata, commonly known as the Chinese water clover, is a plant species in the family Polypodiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Selliguea bisulcata are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and swelling, prevent infections, and protect cells from oxidative damage. The bioactive constituents of Selliguea bisulcata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
